name: Further Concerns
summary: Marshal Dughan sends an Alliance courier east from Goldshire to check reports of danger. You cross Elwynn Forest to speak with Guard Thomas, who watches the river crossing toward Redridge.

sections.title: Eyes on the Eastern Crossing
sections.body: Rumors tell of hostile aquatic creatures creeping along Elwynn's riverbanks. Marshal Dughan commands the Goldshire garrison, where banditry and vermin already trouble the center of the forest. He will not dismiss the reports, but he cannot spare guards from town. Instead, he sends you east to consult Guard Thomas, the sentry at the bridge over the river toward Redridge.

sections.title: A Frontier Stretched Thin
sections.body: Guard Thomas has held the bridge outpost for more than a week and has seen what Goldshire's leaders only feared. Hostile, semi-intelligent murlocs have made camps along the waterways of eastern Elwynn. Stormwind's army is absent, while local garrisons protect town walls and supply lines. That leaves rural bridge posts like Thomas's isolated before the growing danger.

faq.q: Why does Marshal Dughan send me to Guard Thomas?
faq.answer: Marshal Dughan sends you to Guard Thomas because reports tell of murlocs creeping into the eastern waterways. Thomas has been stationed at the eastern Elwynn bridge for a week, so Dughan trusts him to confirm the threat.
Guard Thomas watches the wooden bridge over the river in far eastern Elwynn Forest, on the road toward the Redridge Mountains.

faq.q: What threat does Guard Thomas confirm?
faq.answer: Guard Thomas confirms that hostile, semi-intelligent murlocs have settled along eastern Elwynn's streams and waterways, threatening travelers and nearby farmsteads.

faq.q: How do you reach Guard Thomas?
faq.answer: Take the road east from Goldshire across Elwynn Forest to the bridge over the eastern river, where Guard Thomas keeps watch.

faq.q: Why doesn't Stormwind send an army to help eastern Elwynn?
faq.answer: Stormwind's forces are stretched thin with King Varian Wrynn missing and resources diverted from the countryside. Sentries such as Guard Thomas are left largely to rely on passing adventurers.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Guard Thomas?
faq.answer: After confirming the murloc presence, Guard Thomas asks you to investigate what became of the other sentries who patrolled the riverbank and failed to return.

angles.text: For the Alliance, the thin defenses near the capital reveal growing operational cracks in the Kingdom of Stormwind.
As a human of Elwynn, you face murlocs whose spread threatens the breadbasket farms and the trade routes connecting Goldshire to Lakeshire.
